name: University of Illinois at Chicago
description: The University of Illinois at Chicago campus is in the Near West Side community area, adjacent to the Chicago Loop and is the largest university in the Chicago area, having more than 33,000 students enrolled in 16 colleges. In the 2019 U.S. News & World Report's ranking of colleges and universities, the University of Illinois at Chicago ranked as the 129th best national university and the 61st best national public university.
